title: Cosmic Potato Upgrade — Anisotropy Uncertainty and Geometry Separation
status: archive-generated uncertainty extension of the Laniakea kinematic ellipsoid benchmark; derived from published central values and quoted marginal errors, not a replacement for the original covariance analysis
purpose: Upgrade the archive-derived shear-to-expansion statistic from a central-value curiosity into an uncertainty-aware quantity and separate kinematic anisotropy from geometric shape more rigorously.

anisotropy_statistic.interpretation: A_sigma near unity means the magnitude of the traceless directional shear is comparable to the magnitude of the isotropic expansion/contraction term in this compact summary. It does not itself imply a particular geometric boundary shape.

uncertainty_propagation.method: Archive Monte Carlo propagation using Gaussian marginals as an illustrative approximation because the full published covariance matrix was not supplied in the parent record.

trace_projected_approximation.method: Sample the quoted marginal shear components, then project each sampled triplet onto the traceless subspace sigma_a+sigma_b+sigma_c=0 before computing A_sigma.

uncertainty_propagation.warning: These intervals are methodological placeholders, not publication-grade confidence intervals. Correlations among theta and shear eigenvalues can materially change them. The next proper step is covariance-aware propagation from the source analysis or posterior samples.

important_separation.geometric_triaxiality: Axis ratios q=b/a and s=c/a summarize a chosen geometric boundary or covariance ellipsoid.
important_separation.topology_and_roughness: Euler characteristic, Minkowski functionals and boundary roughness describe still different properties.
important_separation.rule: Do not infer geometric potatoness from A_sigma alone. A flow field may be strongly anisotropic inside a boundary that is not especially ellipsoidal, and an ellipsoidal boundary can coexist with weak shear.

proposed_joint_descriptor.triaxiality: T=(a^2-b^2)/(a^2-c^2) for ordered a>=b>=c where appropriate; T near 0 is oblate-like and T near 1 prolate-like, but this descriptor should not be overinterpreted when the boundary is strongly irregular.
proposed_joint_descriptor.advantage: Separating kinematic, geometric and topological coordinates prevents one attractive number from absorbing unrelated kinds of structure.

model_selection_upgrade.sphere_vs_ellipsoid: Compare an isotropic velocity-gradient model E=lambda I against a symmetric anisotropic E with shear terms using held-out likelihood or predictive residuals.
model_selection_upgrade.ellipsoid_vs_potato: Only add boundary roughness/irregular modes after the triaxial ellipsoid has been fit; penalize additional modes and evaluate them on held-out spatial regions or independent tracers.
systematics: change the frame and peculiar-velocity reconstruction within defensible choices
repeat with bootstrap or posterior samples of the velocity field
report principal-axis orientation uncertainty as well as eigenvalue uncertainty

advancement_gate.promote_kinematic_claim_if: An anisotropic velocity model gives stable out-of-sample improvement over an isotropic/spherical baseline across reasonable reconstruction choices.
advancement_gate.promote_project_specific_shape_if: A predeclared compact-triaxial-plus-irregular descriptor improves morphology or flow prediction beyond ordinary ellipsoid/watershed models enough to justify its added complexity.
advancement_gate.downgrade_if: If the inferred anisotropy or morphology changes substantially under reasonable reconstruction, centering or boundary choices, classify the result as reconstruction-sensitive rather than a robust Cosmic Potato signature.

scientific_value: The improvement is not that A_sigma is near one. The value is that the project now has a covariance-sensitive test separating velocity anisotropy, geometry and topology, making it possible for one part of the historical intuition to survive while another fails.
